features.featureTitle: Display Principal ID, internal UserID, and all active canister IDs with their functions on the Banco Central page. Show the following canisters with their descriptions: crjop-jyaaa-aaaah-atfaq-cai (Frontend/UI - page and interface control), ckmsk-taaaa-aaaah-atfca-cai (Game Logic/Profile/Progression - XP, QMY/ICP coins, captured monsters), nemlr-6aaaa-aaaan-q32la-cai (Governance/Treasury - bonus and rewards distribution), ippxc-5iaaa-aaaae-qgwqq-cai (Main Profile/Unified UserID - real site ↔ app synchronization), x5shd-hqaaa-aaaap-qrdgq-cai (DAO/Game Data Warehouse - transaction history, player actions), i7nyb-2yaaa-aaaaj-qowiq-cai (Bridge/Integration - communication between additional canisters), lkawl-3qaaa-aaaac-qdsoq-cai (Extra Canister/Supplementary Game Data). Present this information in a clear, organized, and readable format.

Ensure all profile data, progression, coins, and bonuses are accessible via the unified canister architecture listed in REQ-1. Confirm that no data depends on separate Principals and that the system uses the internal UserID for data storage and retrieval across all canisters.
